title.narrative: Outcome 1: Adoption of proper hygiene and sanitation practices in four poor vulnerable communities in three Provinces

description.narrative: At least 86,700 people reached with COVID19 messaging on prevention and access to services with an average household size of 3.51 for the target areas and 5,000 households targeted, this will result in 17,500 people (to be in households reached through IEC messaging & Health Ambassadors and at least 40% reached through 4 Community Radio Stations. The following are the radio stations with their listenership: Sekgosese Community Radio (31000), Radio Khwezi (68000), Maruleng Community Radio (22000) and Mosupatsela Community Radio (47000).

title.narrative: Proportion of population using safely managed sanitation services

description.narrative: The Proportion of population using safely managed sanitation services, including a handwashing facility with soap and water is currently being measured by the proportion of the population using a basic sanitation facility which is not shared with other households and where excreta is safely disposed in situ or treated offsite. `Improved sanitation facilities include: flush or pour flush toilets to sewer systems, septic tanks or pit latrines, ventilated improved pit latrines, pit latrines with a slab, and composting toilets. Population with a basic handwashing facility: a device to contain, transport or regulate the flow of water to facilitate handwashing with soap and water in the household.Data reported against SDG indicators can be retrieved from the official UN SDG Database and Statistics https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/unsdg. Users are not expected to encode values for these indicators.For more information, see the SDG indicators metadata at https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata/files/Metadata060201.pdf

title.narrative: Outcome 2: Increased access to WASH Services for four vulnerable communities to limit the spread of COVID19 and other WASHrelated diseases

description.narrative: Provided 36 Water storage facilities in central community points. Provided 4 schools/ECD centre with water storage facilities. Installed 25 Hand washing stations in schools. Installed 13 Hand Washing stations in clinics. Provided 7 community central points with Hand Washing Stations. Capacitated 361 Community Leaders on COVID19, Risk Communication & Community Engagement and Water Harvesting. Reached 279 679 community members with Risk Communication for improved health and hygiene practices. Provided 5000 most vulnerable households with cleaning and hygiene kits. Reached 106 213 community members through radio and print media, on practices to prevent COVID19 and promote health and hygiene behaviour. Facilitated 149 health and hygiene behaviour change campaigns in communities, health facilities and schools on COVID19 prevention strategies
